system.description:
You swirl your chakra-laced claws around you in a tightening spiral with the intent of rending a foes potential clear from their being, disrupting their flow of chakra and shattering their body.

First, you cover your body in draconic chakra manifesting dragon claws before striking at all creatures in range. Make a melee Ninjutsu attack, comparing the result vs the AC of all hostile creatures within 20 feet of you, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage]) + 6d6 damage as you rend them.

Next, damaged creatures must make a Charisma saving throw as you attempt to rend them of a core aspect of themselves. On a failure, select one Keyword between the following, they cannot cast jutsu with the select keyword for the duration; Earth Release, Wind Release, Fire Release, Water Release, Lightning Release, Medical, Fuinjutsu.

Creatures that failed their saving throw remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on them on a success.

Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, by spending 3 Draconic Chakra, select one creature you hit with the attack made as part of this jutsu, forcing them to make their saving throw at disadvantage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6.
